note: Ceilings (C1-C4) are from failure_and_loop_guards.md SS3 -- derived from graph shape, defensible without measurement. This is NOT the same as a Stage 15 budget: THRESHOLD_NOT_DEFINED applies to the real per-task cost cap until U1 is measured at 20a.

scenarios.description: A synthetic run stays within every structural ceiling: <=6 LLM calls (G1), <=150000 tokens/run (C1), <=40000 tokens/single call (C2).

Adversarial: a run exceeds the token ceiling C1 (150000) -- per failure_and_loop_guards.md SS3, this means a structural cap failed to hold; terminal_state must be abstained/ceiling_exceeded, not a truncated answer.

Adversarial: llm_calls=7 exceeds G1's structural cap of 6 -- should be structurally unreachable per the graph's own edges (no 7th call is representable), so observing 7 in a trace is itself the finding.
Real cost-per-successful-task threshold check -- deliberately not evaluated to pass/fail; the number does not exist until Stage 15 (U1 measured at 20a).
